# Generated by tools/build_managers.py.
# Army Readiness: the counted figures, the list of generals with troops and where they stand, and the
# equipment list, for the country in scope. Runs at the start of a game for every country, each day for a
# player, and on a click.
mod1440_ar_count = {
	set_temp_variable = { ar_player = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_player = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_ar_names_fr = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_names = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_names_fr = 2 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_ar_low_str = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_ar_low_org = 0 }
	every_country_division = {
		limit = { unit_strength < 0.75 }
		add_to_variable = { PREV.mod1440_ar_low_str = 1 }
	}
	every_country_division = {
		limit = { unit_organization < 0.5 }
		add_to_variable = { PREV.mod1440_ar_low_org = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_ar_fuel = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { max_fuel_k > 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_fuel = fuel_k }
		divide_variable = { mod1440_ar_fuel = max_fuel_k }
		multiply_variable = { mod1440_ar_fuel = 100 }
		clamp_variable = { var = mod1440_ar_fuel min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	mod1440_ar_map = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ar_player = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_begun = 1 } }
		mod1440_tk_check = yes
	}
	mod1440_of_refs = yes
	set_temp_variable = { ar_sel = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_has_sel = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_sel = mod1440_ar_sel }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { ar_found = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ar_fight = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ar_led = 0 }
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_l_game
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_lk_div
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_lk_fight
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_lk_plan
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_lk_equip
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_lk_worst
	every_army_leader = {
		limit = { check_variable = { num_units > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_leading_army = yes }
			add_to_temp_variable = { ar_fight = num_units_in_combat }
			add_to_temp_variable = { ar_led = num_units }
		}
		mod1440_of_me = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { of_me = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_fill = 101 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wk = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { al_have = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { al_need = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ar_map = 1 } }
				mod1440_ar_worst_1 = yes
			}
			else = {
				mod1440_ar_worst_0 = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_al_fill > 100 } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_al_fill = 100 }
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_eq = 100 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { al_need > 0 } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_al_eq = al_have }
				divide_variable = { mod1440_al_eq = al_need }
				multiply_variable = { mod1440_al_eq = 100 }
				clamp_variable = { var = mod1440_al_eq min = 0 max = 100 }
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_hq = state_deployed }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_plan = avg_unit_planning_ratio }
			multiply_variable = { mod1440_al_plan = 100 }
			clamp_variable = { var = mod1440_al_plan min = 0 max = 100 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_oth = num_units }
			subtract_from_variable = { mod1440_al_oth = num_infantry }
			subtract_from_variable = { mod1440_al_oth = num_armored }
			subtract_from_variable = { mod1440_al_oth = num_motorized }
			subtract_from_variable = { mod1440_al_oth = num_mechanized }
			clamp_variable = { var = mod1440_al_oth min = 0 max = 10000 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_loc = 0 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_lcnt = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ar_player = 1 } OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 95029 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
				mod1440_p_officer = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { of_me = ar_sel } }
				set_temp_variable = { ar_found = 1 }
			}
			add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_ar_l_game = of_me }
			add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_ar_lk_div = num_units }
			add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_ar_lk_fight = num_units_in_combat }
			add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_ar_lk_plan = mod1440_al_plan }
			add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_ar_lk_equip = mod1440_al_eq }
			add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_ar_lk_worst = mod1440_al_fill }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_has_sel = 1 } check_variable = { ar_found = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_has_sel = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_ar_fight = ar_fight }
	set_variable = { mod1440_ar_nocmd = num_divisions }
	subtract_from_variable = { mod1440_ar_nocmd = ar_led }
	clamp_variable = { var = mod1440_ar_nocmd min = 0 max = 100000 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ar_player = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_me = THIS }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = controlled_states
			mod1440_ar_here = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { NOT = { tag = PREV } OR = { is_in_faction_with = PREV has_war_with = PREV } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = controlled_states
				mod1440_ar_here = yes
			}
		}
	}
	mod1440_ar_al_sort = yes
	mod1440_ar_marks = yes
	mod1440_ar_list = yes
	set_variable = { mod1440_ar_counted = global.date }
}

# Army Readiness: for the state in scope, the commanders with troops of the country ar_me; each keeps the
# state where he has the most divisions (mod1440_al_loc, and their number mod1440_al_lcnt).
mod1440_ar_here = {
	set_temp_variable = { ar_st = THIS }
	var:ar_me = {
		every_army_leader = {
			limit = { check_variable = { num_units > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { al_n = num_units_in_state@var:ar_st }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { al_n > mod1440_al_lcnt } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_al_lcnt = al_n }
				set_variable = { mod1440_al_loc = ar_st }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Army Readiness: the table of kinds of the loaded map, in the temporary ar_map (0: the game's own).
mod1440_ar_map = {
	set_temp_variable = { ar_map = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_states = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_n = 0 }
		every_state = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { ar_n = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_states = ar_n }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_states = 1143 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_map = 1 }
	}
}

# Army Readiness: the equipment list of the country in scope, from its stock and its divisions, or from the
# chosen army's, with the figures of the equipment; then the order of the chosen column.
mod1440_ar_list = {
	mod1440_ar_map = yes
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_u_kind
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_u_pic
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_u_cls
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_u_stock
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_u_field
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_u_need
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_u_short
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_u_fill
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_u_red
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_u_key
	set_temp_variable = { ar_listing = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_has_sel = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_listing = 0 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { ar_have_k = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ar_need_k = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ar_ks = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ar_kr = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ar_map = 1 } }
		mod1440_ar_kinds_1 = yes
	}
	else = {
		mod1440_ar_kinds_0 = yes
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_ar_eqn = ar_need_k }
	set_variable = { mod1440_ar_eqf = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ar_need_k > 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_eqf = ar_have_k }
		divide_variable = { mod1440_ar_eqf = ar_need_k }
		multiply_variable = { mod1440_ar_eqf = 100 }
		clamp_variable = { var = mod1440_ar_eqf min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_ar_kshort = ar_ks }
	set_variable = { mod1440_ar_kred = ar_kr }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_has_sel = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ar_map = 1 } }
			mod1440_ar_akinds_1 = yes
		}
		else = {
			mod1440_ar_akinds_0 = yes
		}
	}
	mod1440_ar_eq_sort = yes
}

# Army Readiness: a kind in use, from ar_s (stock), ar_f (in the field) and ar_d (needed).
mod1440_ar_calc = {
	set_temp_variable = { ar_fill = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ar_short = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ar_red = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ar_key = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ar_d > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_fill = ar_f }
		divide_temp_variable = { ar_fill = ar_d }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ar_fill = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ar_fill > 100 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ar_fill = 100 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { ar_short = ar_d }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { ar_short = ar_f }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ar_short < 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ar_short = 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { ar_whole = ar_short }
		round_temp_variable = ar_whole
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { var = ar_whole value = ar_short compare = less_than } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { ar_whole = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { ar_short = ar_whole }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ar_short > 0 } check_variable = { var = ar_s value = ar_short compare = less_than } }
			set_temp_variable = { ar_red = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { ar_key = 200 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { ar_key = ar_fill }
	}
}

# Army Readiness: a kind into the unsorted arrays of the list, with ar_tok, ar_pic and ar_cls.
mod1440_ar_add = {
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_u_kind = ar_tok }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_u_pic = ar_pic }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_u_cls = ar_cls }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_u_stock = ar_s }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_u_field = ar_f }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_u_need = ar_d }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_u_short = ar_short }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_u_fill = ar_fill }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_u_red = ar_red }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_u_key = ar_key }
}

# Army Readiness: a kind the country's divisions need, into the figures of the head.
mod1440_ar_tally = {
	set_temp_variable = { ar_t = ar_f }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ar_t > ar_d } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_t = ar_d }
	}
	divide_temp_variable = { ar_t = 1000 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ar_have_k = ar_t }
	set_temp_variable = { ar_t = ar_d }
	divide_temp_variable = { ar_t = 1000 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ar_need_k = ar_t }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ar_short > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { ar_ks = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ar_red = 1 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { ar_kr = 1 }
	}
}

# Army Readiness: a kind a general's divisions need (al_h of al_t) into al_have and al_need, in thousands.
mod1440_ar_held = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { al_h > al_t } }
		set_temp_variable = { al_h = al_t }
	}
	divide_temp_variable = { al_h = 1000 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { al_have = al_h }
	divide_temp_variable = { al_t = 1000 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { al_need = al_t }
}

# Army Readiness: the equipment list in the order of its chosen column (mod1440_ar_eq_by, _up), from the
# unsorted arrays of the last list. Counts nothing.
mod1440_ar_eq_sort = {
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_kind
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_pic
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_cls
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_stock
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_field
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_need
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_short
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_fill
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_red
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_odd
	set_temp_variable = { ar_par = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_by = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_asc = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_arrow_x = 345 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_by = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_asc = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_arrow_x = 437 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_by = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_asc = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_arrow_x = 525 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_by = 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_asc = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_arrow_x = 613 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_by = 4 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_asc = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_arrow_x = 701 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_by = 5 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_asc = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_arrow_x = 890 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_up = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ar_asc = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ar_asc = 0 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { ar_asc = 1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_asc = ar_asc }
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_eq_keys
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_ar_u_key^num
		value = ar_i
		set_temp_variable = { ar_v = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_by = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ar_v = mod1440_ar_u_key^ar_i }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_by = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ar_v = mod1440_ar_u_stock^ar_i }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_by = 2 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ar_v = mod1440_ar_u_field^ar_i }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_by = 3 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ar_v = mod1440_ar_u_need^ar_i }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_by = 4 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ar_v = mod1440_ar_u_short^ar_i }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_by = 5 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ar_v = 101 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_u_need^ar_i > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ar_v = mod1440_ar_u_fill^ar_i }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ar_asc = 1 } }
			multiply_temp_variable = { ar_v = -1 }
		}
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_eq_keys = ar_v }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_ar_u_key^num
		value = ar_step
		find_highest_in_array = {
			array = mod1440_ar_eq_keys
			value = ar_high
			index = ar_at
		}
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_kind = mod1440_ar_u_kind^ar_at }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_pic = mod1440_ar_u_pic^ar_at }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_cls = mod1440_ar_u_cls^ar_at }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_stock = mod1440_ar_u_stock^ar_at }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_field = mod1440_ar_u_field^ar_at }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_need = mod1440_ar_u_need^ar_at }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_short = mod1440_ar_u_short^ar_at }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_fill = mod1440_ar_u_fill^ar_at }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_red = mod1440_ar_u_red^ar_at }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_odd = ar_par }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ar_par = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ar_par = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { ar_par = 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_eq_keys^ar_at = -2100000 }
	}
}

# Army Readiness: the armies in the order of their chosen column (mod1440_ar_al_by, _up), from the game's
# order and the keys of the last count. Counts nothing.
mod1440_ar_al_sort = {
	clear_array = mod1440_ar_leaders
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_by = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_asc = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_arrow_x = 313 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_by = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_asc = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_arrow_x = 489 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_by = 8 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_asc = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_arrow_x = 713 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_by = 9 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_asc = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_arrow_x = 771 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_by = 10 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_asc = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_arrow_x = 829 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_by = 11 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_asc = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_arrow_x = 890 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_up = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ar_asc = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ar_asc = 0 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { ar_asc = 1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_asc = ar_asc }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_by = 0 } }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_ar_l_game
			value = ar_l
			add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_leaders = ar_l }
		}
	}
	else = {
		clear_array = mod1440_ar_al_keys
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_ar_l_game^num
			value = ar_i
			set_temp_variable = { ar_v = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_by = 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ar_v = 0 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_by = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ar_v = mod1440_ar_lk_div^ar_i }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_by = 8 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ar_v = mod1440_ar_lk_fight^ar_i }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_by = 9 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ar_v = mod1440_ar_lk_plan^ar_i }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_by = 10 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ar_v = mod1440_ar_lk_equip^ar_i }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_by = 11 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ar_v = mod1440_ar_lk_worst^ar_i }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ar_asc = 1 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { ar_v = -1 }
			}
			add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_al_keys = ar_v }
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_ar_l_game^num
			value = ar_step
			find_highest_in_array = {
				array = mod1440_ar_al_keys
				value = ar_high
				index = ar_at
			}
			add_to_array = { mod1440_ar_leaders = mod1440_ar_l_game^ar_at }
			set_variable = { mod1440_ar_al_keys^ar_at = -2100000 }
		}
	}
}

# Army Readiness: the band of every second army row and the light band of the chosen army.
mod1440_ar_marks = {
	set_temp_variable = { ar_sel = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_has_sel = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ar_sel = mod1440_ar_sel }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { al_odd = 0 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_ar_leaders
		value = ar_l
		var:ar_l = {
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_odd = al_odd }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_pick = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ar_l = ar_sel } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_al_pick = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { al_odd = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { al_odd = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { al_odd = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Army Readiness: a click on the row of the commander of_me, for the country in scope.
mod1440_ar_choose = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_has_sel = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_ar_sel = of_me } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_has_sel = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { of_me = 0 } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_sel = of_me }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_has_sel = 1 }
	}
	mod1440_ar_list = yes
	mod1440_ar_marks = yes
}

		mod1440_ar_held = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { num_target_equipment@super_heavy_tank_artillery_chassis > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { al_t = num_target_equipment@super_heavy_tank_artillery_chassis }
		set_temp_variable = { al_h = num_equipment@super_heavy_tank_artillery_chassis }
		set_temp_variable = { al_share = al_h }
		divide_temp_variable = { al_share = al_t }
		multiply_temp_variable = { al_share = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { al_share < mod1440_al_fill } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_fill = al_share }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wk = 1 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wpic = token:GFX_archetype_super_heavy_tank_equipment_medium }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wcls = 5 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wkind = token:super_heavy_tank_artillery_chassis }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_whave = al_h }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wneed = al_t }
		}
		mod1440_ar_held = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { num_target_equipment@super_heavy_tank_chassis > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { al_t = num_target_equipment@super_heavy_tank_chassis }
		set_temp_variable = { al_h = num_equipment@super_heavy_tank_chassis }
		set_temp_variable = { al_share = al_h }
		divide_temp_variable = { al_share = al_t }
		multiply_temp_variable = { al_share = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { al_share < mod1440_al_fill } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_fill = al_share }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wk = 1 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wpic = token:GFX_archetype_super_heavy_tank_equipment_medium }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wcls = 5 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wkind = token:super_heavy_tank_chassis }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_whave = al_h }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wneed = al_t }
		}
		mod1440_ar_held = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { num_target_equipment@super_heavy_tank_destroyer_chassis > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { al_t = num_target_equipment@super_heavy_tank_destroyer_chassis }
		set_temp_variable = { al_h = num_equipment@super_heavy_tank_destroyer_chassis }
		set_temp_variable = { al_share = al_h }
		divide_temp_variable = { al_share = al_t }
		multiply_temp_variable = { al_share = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { al_share < mod1440_al_fill } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_fill = al_share }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wk = 1 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wpic = token:GFX_archetype_super_heavy_tank_equipment_medium }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wcls = 5 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wkind = token:super_heavy_tank_destroyer_chassis }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_whave = al_h }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wneed = al_t }
		}
		mod1440_ar_held = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { num_target_equipment@wheeled_tank_chassis > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { al_t = num_target_equipment@wheeled_tank_chassis }
		set_temp_variable = { al_h = num_equipment@wheeled_tank_chassis }
		set_temp_variable = { al_share = al_h }
		divide_temp_variable = { al_share = al_t }
		multiply_temp_variable = { al_share = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { al_share < mod1440_al_fill } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_fill = al_share }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wk = 1 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wpic = token:GFX_archetype_light_tank_equipment_medium }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wcls = 4 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wkind = token:wheeled_tank_chassis }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_whave = al_h }
			set_variable = { mod1440_al_wneed = al_t }
		}
		mod1440_ar_held = yes
	}
}

# States: makes the list of the page again, for the country in scope. For each state it controls: count the
# free shared slots and what the cards need, keep the state if the choices of the page want it and add it
# to the totals; then sort, and choose the state of the cards.
mod1440_st_list = {
	clear_array = mod1440_st_rows
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_free = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_infra = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_civ = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_mil = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_dock = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_refinery = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_silo = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_air = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_aa = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_radar = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_oil = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_aluminium = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_rubber = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_tungsten = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_steel = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_chromium = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_coal = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_sum_pop = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = controlled_states
		if = {
			limit = {
				free_building_slots = {
					building = industrial_complex
					size > 15
					include_locked = no
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					free_building_slots = {
						building = industrial_complex
						size > 23
						include_locked = no
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						free_building_slots = {
							building = industrial_complex
							size > 27
							include_locked = no
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							free_building_slots = {
								building = industrial_complex
								size > 29
								include_locked = no
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								free_building_slots = {
									building = industrial_complex
									size > 30
									include_locked = no
								}
							}
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 31 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 30 }
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = {
								free_building_slots = {
									building = industrial_complex
									size > 28
									include_locked = no
								}
							}
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 29 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 28 }
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							free_building_slots = {
								building = industrial_complex
								size > 25
								include_locked = no
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								free_building_slots = {
									building = industrial_complex
									size > 26
									include_locked = no
								}
							}
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 27 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 26 }
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = {
								free_building_slots = {
									building = industrial_complex
									size > 24
									include_locked = no
								}
							}
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 25 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 24 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						free_building_slots = {
							building = industrial_complex
							size > 19
							include_locked = no
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							free_building_slots = {
								building = industrial_complex
								size > 21
								include_locked = no
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								free_building_slots = {
									building = industrial_complex
									size > 22
									include_locked = no
								}
							}
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 23 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 22 }
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = {
								free_building_slots = {
									building = industrial_complex
									size > 20
									include_locked = no
								}
							}
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 21 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 20 }
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							free_building_slots = {
								building = industrial_complex
								size > 17
								include_locked = no
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								free_building_slots = {
									building = industrial_complex
									size > 18
									include_locked = no
								}
							}
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 19 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 18 }
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = {
								free_building_slots = {
									building = industrial_complex
									size > 16
									include_locked = no
								}
							}
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 17 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 16 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					free_building_slots = {
						building = industrial_complex
						size > 7
						include_locked = no
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						free_building_slots = {
							building = industrial_complex
							size > 11
							include_locked = no
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							free_building_slots = {
								building = industrial_complex
								size > 13
								include_locked = no
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								free_building_slots = {
									building = industrial_complex
									size > 14
									include_locked = no
								}
							}
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 15 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 14 }
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = {
								free_building_slots = {
									building = industrial_complex
									size > 12
									include_locked = no
								}
							}
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 13 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 12 }
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							free_building_slots = {
								building = industrial_complex
								size > 9
								include_locked = no
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								free_building_slots = {
									building = industrial_complex
									size > 10
									include_locked = no
								}
							}
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 11 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 10 }
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = {
								free_building_slots = {
									building = industrial_complex
									size > 8
									include_locked = no
								}
							}
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 9 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 8 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						free_building_slots = {
							building = industrial_complex
							size > 3
							include_locked = no
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							free_building_slots = {
								building = industrial_complex
								size > 5
								include_locked = no
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								free_building_slots = {
									building = industrial_complex
									size > 6
									include_locked = no
								}
							}
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 7 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 6 }
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = {
								free_building_slots = {
									building = industrial_complex
									size > 4
									include_locked = no
								}
							}
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 5 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 4 }
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							free_building_slots = {
								building = industrial_complex
								size > 1
								include_locked = no
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								free_building_slots = {
									building = industrial_complex
									size > 2
									include_locked = no
								}
							}
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 3 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 2 }
						}
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = {
								free_building_slots = {
									building = industrial_complex
									size > 0
									include_locked = no
								}
							}
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 1 }
						}
						else = {
							set_variable = { mod1440_st_free = 0 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_used_n = building_level@industrial_complex }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_used_n = building_level@arms_factory }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_used_n = building_level@dockyard }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_used_n = building_level@synthetic_refinery }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_used_n = building_level@fuel_silo }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_used_other = 0 }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_used_other = building_level@rocket_site }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_used_other = building_level@nuclear_reactor }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_used_other = building_level@nuclear_reactor_heavy_water }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_used_other = building_level@commercial_nuclear_reactor }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_used_other = building_level@energy_infrastructure }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_used_other = building_level@industrial_infrastructure }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_used_other = building_level@mega_gun_emplacement }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_used_other = building_level@stronghold_network }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_used_n = mod1440_st_used_other }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_slots = mod1440_st_free }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_slots = mod1440_st_used_n }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_used = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_slots > 0 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_used = mod1440_st_used_n }
			multiply_variable = { mod1440_st_used = 100 }
			divide_variable = { mod1440_st_used = mod1440_st_slots }
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_r_oil = resource@oil }
		round_variable = mod1440_st_r_oil
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_r_aluminium = resource@aluminium }
		round_variable = mod1440_st_r_aluminium
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_r_rubber = resource@rubber }
		round_variable = mod1440_st_r_rubber
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_r_tungsten = resource@tungsten }
		round_variable = mod1440_st_r_tungsten
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_r_steel = resource@steel }
		round_variable = mod1440_st_r_steel
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_r_chromium = resource@chromium }
		round_variable = mod1440_st_r_chromium
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_r_coal = resource@coal }
		round_variable = mod1440_st_r_coal
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_dmg = 0 }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_dmg = damaged_building_level@infrastructure }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_dmg = damaged_building_level@industrial_complex }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_dmg = damaged_building_level@arms_factory }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_dmg = damaged_building_level@dockyard }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_dmg = damaged_building_level@synthetic_refinery }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_dmg = damaged_building_level@fuel_silo }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_dmg = damaged_building_level@air_base }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_dmg = damaged_building_level@anti_air_building }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_dmg = damaged_building_level@radar_station }
		if = {
			limit = { has_state_category = megalopolis }
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_cat = token:megalopolis }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_state_category = metropolis }
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_cat = token:metropolis }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_state_category = large_city }
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_cat = token:large_city }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_state_category = city }
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_cat = token:city }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_state_category = large_town }
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_cat = token:large_town }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_state_category = town }
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_cat = token:town }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_state_category = rural }
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_cat = token:rural }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_state_category = pastoral }
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_cat = token:pastoral }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_state_category = wasteland }
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_cat = token:wasteland }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_state_category = enclave }
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_cat = token:enclave }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_state_category = large_island }
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_cat = token:large_island }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_state_category = small_island }
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_cat = token:small_island }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_state_category = tiny_island }
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_cat = token:tiny_island }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_cat = 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_picked = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { st_keep = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_show = 1 }
				NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { st_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_show = 2 }
				is_core_of = ROOT
			}
			set_temp_variable = { st_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_only_free = 1 }
				check_variable = { mod1440_st_free < 1 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { st_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { st_keep = 1 } }
			add_to_array = { ROOT.mod1440_st_rows = THIS }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_free = mod1440_st_free }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_infra = infrastructure_level }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_civ = industrial_complex_level }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_mil = arms_factory_level }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_dock = building_level@dockyard }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_refinery = building_level@synthetic_refinery }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_silo = building_level@fuel_silo }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_air = building_level@air_base }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_aa = building_level@anti_air_building }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_radar = building_level@radar_station }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_oil = mod1440_st_r_oil }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_aluminium = mod1440_st_r_aluminium }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_rubber = mod1440_st_r_rubber }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_tungsten = mod1440_st_r_tungsten }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_steel = mod1440_st_r_steel }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_chromium = mod1440_st_r_chromium }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_coal = mod1440_st_r_coal }
			add_to_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sum_pop = state_population_k }
		}
	}
	mod1440_st_sort = yes
	set_temp_variable = { st_odd = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = mod1440_st_rows
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_odd = st_odd }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { st_odd = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { st_odd = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { st_odd = 0 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 311 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 373 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 3 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 425 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 4 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 477 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 5 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 529 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 6 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 581 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 7 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 633 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 8 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 685 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 9 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 737 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 10 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 789 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 11 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 855 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 12 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 911 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 13 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 967 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 14 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 1023 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 15 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 1079 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 16 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 1135 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 17 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 1191 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 18 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 1285 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 19 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 1355 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by = 20 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_arrow_x = 1415 }

	set_variable = { mod1440_st_frame_0 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_frame_1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_frame_2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_st_frame_free = 1 }

		set_variable = { mod1440_st_frame_1 = 2 }

		set_variable = { mod1440_st_frame_free = 2 }
	}
	mod1440_st_pick = yes
}

# States: the state of the cards, for the country in scope. The one in mod1440_st_sel if it is listed, else
# the first of the list. Its row gets the mark of the chosen row, the others lose theirs (as on the Officers page).
mod1440_st_pick = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = mod1440_st_rows
		set_variable = { mod1440_st_picked = 0 }
	}
	clear_array = mod1440_st_card
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_rows^num > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_st_rows value = mod1440_st_sel } } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_sel = mod1440_st_rows^0 }
		}
		var:mod1440_st_sel = {
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_picked = 1 }
		}
		add_to_array = { mod1440_st_card = mod1440_st_sel }
	}
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_st_dirty = 1 }
}

# States: puts the list into the order of the chosen column, largest first, or smallest first when turned.
# The search for the next largest is the game's own loop, so 150 states take a few milliseconds (X22).
mod1440_st_sort = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_st_sort_by > 0 } }
		clear_array = mod1440_st_keys
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = mod1440_st_rows
			set_temp_variable = { st_key = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = mod1440_st_free }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = infrastructure_level }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = industrial_complex_level }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = arms_factory_level }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = building_level@dockyard }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = building_level@synthetic_refinery }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 7 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = building_level@fuel_silo }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 8 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = building_level@air_base }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 9 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = building_level@anti_air_building }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 10 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = building_level@radar_station }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 11 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = mod1440_st_r_oil }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 12 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = mod1440_st_r_aluminium }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 13 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = mod1440_st_r_rubber }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 14 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = mod1440_st_r_tungsten }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 15 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = mod1440_st_r_steel }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 16 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = mod1440_st_r_chromium }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 17 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = mod1440_st_r_coal }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 18 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = state_population_k }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 19 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = compliance }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_sort_by = 20 } }
				set_temp_variable = { st_key = resistance }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_st_up = 1 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { st_key = -1 }
			}
			add_to_array = { ROOT.mod1440_st_keys = st_key }
		}
		clear_array = mod1440_st_sorted
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_st_rows^num
			value = st_step
			find_highest_in_array = {
				array = mod1440_st_keys
				value = st_high
				index = st_at
			}
			add_to_array = { mod1440_st_sorted = mod1440_st_rows^st_at }
			set_variable = { mod1440_st_keys^st_at = -2000000 }
		}
		clear_array = mod1440_st_rows
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_st_sorted
			value = st_copy
			add_to_array = { mod1440_st_rows = st_copy }
		}
	}
}

# National Figures: how far the bars of the page are filled, 0 to 100, for the country in scope. Runs when
# the page opens and each day for a player; the numbers beside the bars follow the game by themselves.
mod1440_nf_bars = {
	set_variable = { mod1440_nf_stab = stability }
	multiply_variable = { mod1440_nf_stab = 100 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_nf_ws = has_war_support }
	multiply_variable = { mod1440_nf_ws = 100 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_nf_fuel = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { max_fuel_k > 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_nf_fuel = fuel_k }
		divide_variable = { mod1440_nf_fuel = max_fuel_k }
		multiply_variable = { mod1440_nf_fuel = 100 }
		clamp_variable = { var = mod1440_nf_fuel min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
}

# History: writes today's twenty figures of the country in scope down, and forgets the oldest month past ten
# years. Runs at the start of a game for every country and on the first of each month for a player.
mod1440_h_record = {
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_0 = manpower_k }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_1 = deployed_total_manpower_k }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_2 = num_divisions }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_3 = num_of_civilian_factories }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_4 = num_of_military_factories }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_5 = num_of_naval_factories }
	set_temp_variable = { h_v = stability }
	multiply_temp_variable = { h_v = 100 }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_6 = h_v }
	set_temp_variable = { h_v = has_war_support }
	multiply_temp_variable = { h_v = 100 }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_7 = h_v }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_8 = fuel_k }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_9 = num_equipment@infantry_equipment }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_10 = casualties_k }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_11 = political_power }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_12 = amount_research_slots }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_13 = num_researched_technologies }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_14 = command_power }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_15 = num_controlled_states }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_16 = num_equipment@convoy }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_17 = num_equipment@train_equipment }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_18 = num_ships }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_19 = num_deployed_planes }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_date = global.date }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_h_year = global.year }
	set_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_date^num }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_12^num }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { h_p > 0 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = h_p
			value = h_q
			add_to_array = { array = mod1440_h_12 value = -1 index = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_date^num }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_13^num }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { h_p > 0 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = h_p
			value = h_q
			add_to_array = { array = mod1440_h_13 value = -1 index = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_date^num }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_14^num }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { h_p > 0 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = h_p
			value = h_q
			add_to_array = { array = mod1440_h_14 value = -1 index = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_date^num }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_15^num }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { h_p > 0 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = h_p
			value = h_q
			add_to_array = { array = mod1440_h_15 value = -1 index = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_date^num }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_16^num }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { h_p > 0 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = h_p
			value = h_q
			add_to_array = { array = mod1440_h_16 value = -1 index = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_date^num }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_17^num }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { h_p > 0 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = h_p
			value = h_q
			add_to_array = { array = mod1440_h_17 value = -1 index = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_date^num }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_18^num }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { h_p > 0 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = h_p
			value = h_q
			add_to_array = { array = mod1440_h_18 value = -1 index = 0 }

	set_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_date^num }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_19^num }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { h_p > 0 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = h_p
			value = h_q
			add_to_array = { array = mod1440_h_19 value = -1 index = 0 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_h_date^num > 120 } }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_0 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_1 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_2 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_3 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_4 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_5 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_6 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_7 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_8 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_9 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_10 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_11 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_12 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_13 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_14 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_15 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_16 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_17 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_18 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_19 index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_date index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_h_year index = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_nf_open = 1 } }
		mod1440_h_draw = yes
	}
}

# History: today's value and the changes of each figure for the tiles, then the chosen figure as column
# heights, 0 to 240, between the foot of the graph (zero, or the lowest month when zoomed in) and the highest
# month. A month of a newer figure that was not written down (-1) is drawn as no column and counts for nothing.
mod1440_h_draw = {
	set_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_date^num }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_12^num }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { h_p > 0 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = h_p
			value = h_q
			add_to_array = { array = mod1440_h_12 value = -1 index = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_date^num }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_13^num }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { h_p > 0 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = h_p
			value = h_q
			add_to_array = { array = mod1440_h_13 value = -1 index = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_date^num }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_14^num }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { h_p > 0 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = h_p
			value = h_q
			add_to_array = { array = mod1440_h_14 value = -1 index = 0 }
		}
	}

	subtract_from_temp_variable = { h_p = mod1440_h_15^num }

		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0

	subtract_from_temp_variable = { h_i2 = 2 }
	set_temp_variable = { h_i13 = h_n }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { h_i13 = 13 }
	clear_array = mod1440_h_tab_now
	clear_array = mod1440_h_tab_dm
	clear_array = mod1440_h_tab_hm
	clear_array = mod1440_h_tab_dy
	clear_array = mod1440_h_tab_hy

		set_variable = { mod1440_h_has_m = mod1440_h_tab_hm^12 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_has_y = mod1440_h_tab_hy^12 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_h_series = 13 } }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_h_13
			value = h_v
			add_to_array = { mod1440_h_now = h_v }
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dec = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_rise = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { h_skip = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dm = mod1440_h_tab_dm^13 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dy = mod1440_h_tab_dy^13 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_has_m = mod1440_h_tab_hm^13 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_has_y = mod1440_h_tab_hy^13 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_h_series = 14 } }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_h_14
			value = h_v
			add_to_array = { mod1440_h_now = h_v }
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dec = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_rise = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { h_skip = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dm = mod1440_h_tab_dm^14 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dy = mod1440_h_tab_dy^14 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_has_m = mod1440_h_tab_hm^14 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_has_y = mod1440_h_tab_hy^14 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_h_series = 15 } }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_h_15
			value = h_v
			add_to_array = { mod1440_h_now = h_v }
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dec = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_rise = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { h_skip = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dm = mod1440_h_tab_dm^15 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dy = mod1440_h_tab_dy^15 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_has_m = mod1440_h_tab_hm^15 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_has_y = mod1440_h_tab_hy^15 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_h_series = 16 } }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_h_16
			value = h_v
			add_to_array = { mod1440_h_now = h_v }
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dec = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_rise = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { h_skip = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dm = mod1440_h_tab_dm^16 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dy = mod1440_h_tab_dy^16 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_has_m = mod1440_h_tab_hm^16 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_has_y = mod1440_h_tab_hy^16 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_h_series = 17 } }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_h_17
			value = h_v
			add_to_array = { mod1440_h_now = h_v }
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dec = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_rise = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { h_skip = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dm = mod1440_h_tab_dm^17 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dy = mod1440_h_tab_dy^17 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_has_m = mod1440_h_tab_hm^17 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_has_y = mod1440_h_tab_hy^17 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_h_series = 18 } }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_h_18
			value = h_v
			add_to_array = { mod1440_h_now = h_v }
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dec = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_rise = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { h_skip = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dm = mod1440_h_tab_dm^18 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dy = mod1440_h_tab_dy^18 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_has_m = mod1440_h_tab_hm^18 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_has_y = mod1440_h_tab_hy^18 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_h_series = 19 } }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_h_19
			value = h_v
			add_to_array = { mod1440_h_now = h_v }
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dec = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_rise = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { h_skip = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dm = mod1440_h_tab_dm^19 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_dy = mod1440_h_tab_dy^19 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_has_m = mod1440_h_tab_hm^19 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_has_y = mod1440_h_tab_hy^19 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { h_max = 0 }
	find_highest_in_array = {
		array = mod1440_h_now
		value = h_max
		index = h_at
	}
	set_temp_variable = { h_min = h_max }
	set_temp_variable = { h_valid = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { h_first = 0 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_h_now
		value = h_v
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { h_skip = 0 } check_variable = { h_v > -1 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { h_valid = 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { h_first = h_v }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { h_valid = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { h_v < h_min } }
				set_temp_variable = { h_min = h_v }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { h_valid = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { h_max = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { h_min = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_max = h_max }
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_min = h_min }
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_valid = h_valid }
	set_temp_variable = { h_base = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_h_zoom = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { h_base = h_min }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { h_range = h_max }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { h_range = h_base }
	set_temp_variable = { h_quarter = h_range }
	divide_temp_variable = { h_quarter = 4 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_s0 = h_base }
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_s1 = mod1440_h_s0 }
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_h_s1 = h_quarter }
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_s2 = mod1440_h_s1 }
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_h_s2 = h_quarter }
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_s3 = mod1440_h_s2 }
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_h_s3 = h_quarter }
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_s4 = h_max }
	clear_array = mod1440_h_bars
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_h_now
		value = h_v
		set_temp_variable = { h_bar = -1 }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { h_skip = 0 } check_variable = { h_v > -1 } } }
			set_temp_variable = { h_bar = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { h_range > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { h_bar = h_v }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { h_bar = h_base }
				divide_temp_variable = { h_bar = h_range }
				multiply_temp_variable = { h_bar = 240 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { h_v > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { h_bar = 240 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_h_zoom = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { h_bar < 4 } }
					set_temp_variable = { h_bar = 4 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { h_bar < 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { h_bar = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { h_bar > 240 } }
				set_temp_variable = { h_bar = 240 }
			}
		}
		add_to_array = { mod1440_h_bars = h_bar }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 120
		value = h_pad
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_h_year^num < mod1440_h_date^num } }
			add_to_array = { array = mod1440_h_year value = 0 index = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_0 = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_5 = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_6 = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_7 = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_8 = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_9 = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { h_before = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { h_slot = 0 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_h_year
		value = h_y
		index = h_yi
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { h_yi > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { h_y > 0 } }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { h_y = h_before } } }
					set_temp_variable = { h_x = h_yi }
					multiply_temp_variable = { h_x = 12 }
					add_to_temp_variable = { h_x = 84 }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { h_slot = 0 } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_0 = h_y }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yx_0 = h_x }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { h_slot = 1 } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_1 = h_y }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yx_1 = h_x }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { h_slot = 2 } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_2 = h_y }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yx_2 = h_x }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { h_slot = 3 } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_3 = h_y }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yx_3 = h_x }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { h_slot = 4 } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_4 = h_y }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yx_4 = h_x }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { h_slot = 5 } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_5 = h_y }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yx_5 = h_x }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { h_slot = 6 } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_6 = h_y }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yx_6 = h_x }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { h_slot = 7 } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_7 = h_y }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yx_7 = h_x }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { h_slot = 8 } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_8 = h_y }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yx_8 = h_x }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { h_slot = 9 } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yl_9 = h_y }
						set_variable = { mod1440_h_yx_9 = h_x }
					}
					add_to_temp_variable = { h_slot = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { h_before = h_y }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_latest = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_change = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { h_n > 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_latest = mod1440_h_now^h_i1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_change = mod1440_h_latest }
		subtract_from_variable = { mod1440_h_change = h_first }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_first = mod1440_h_date^0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_last = mod1440_h_date^h_i1 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_h_zoom_frame = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_h_zoom = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_h_zoom_frame = 2 }
	}
}
